newsitem.title: USA: Players completes initial Mesquite sale.
newsitem.headline: Players completes initial Mesquite sale.

text.p: Players International Inc Wednesday said it completed the initial closing of the sale of its Mesquite property to Robert Black, Sr and received $22 million in cash proceeds.
The remaining amount of the $30.5 million sale price, including $1.5 million of notes, is payable on the approval of the transaction by the Nevada Gaming Board, or by June 30, 1997.

In connection with the Mesquite sale, the company also said it amended its bank credit agreement, reducing the credit line to $69.5 million from $120 million, reducing applicable facility fees and repayment incentive fees by 76 percent, reducing unused commitment fees by 42 percent and providing for quarterly increases in the interest rate margin of 0.5 percent beginning October 1, 1997.

The company believes the reduced $69.5 million credit line, together with the Mesquite sale proceeds, will be sufficient to fund the remaining expenses associated with its new Maryland Heights, Mo., facility, which opened on March 11, 1997.
